plugins.name: datavessel
plugins.description: Discover and run 200+ analytics & commerce tools (GA4, Search Console, Google/Meta Ads, Shopify, WooCommerce, Shopware) via the datavessel CLI — with an agent hierarchy: autonomous read agents, a human-in-the-loop write agent, and a verifier, plus /datavessel:setup for one-command onboarding.

plugins.name: ai-visibility
plugins.description: Check whether AI assistants recommend your store when a shopper asks what to buy — scored against named competitors, with a named cause per loss and a drafted fix list. Needs no account, API key, or connected data source.
